best_current_winning_path_candidate.name: SELECTIVE_SCORE_DOMINANCE_CONSERVATIVE_SINGLE_3RENHUKU_CORE_VALUE_LANE
best_current_winning_path_candidate.summary: Select only strong frozen PRE score-dominance races, keep exactly one top3 3renhuku ticket, require genuine timestamped PRE price, and permit at most a 100-yen Owner-manual candidate only inside the <=20x CORE when the frozen value condition passes.

new_structural_findings_since_v36.numeric_value_gate_redundancy: Within every current odds band, expected-ROI and probability-multiple thresholds are algebraically the same p*odds cutoff; they are not independent confirmations. Current prespec remains unchanged to avoid threshold drift.
new_structural_findings_since_v36.fallback_consensus_limit: When no exact-rider lookup exists, challenger agreement is a small perturbation of the same competition-score signal rather than independent-model consensus. The maximum style-fallback pairwise spread at |q|=1 equals about 0.263508 score points.
new_structural_findings_since_v36.core_feasibility_floor: p_ticket < 0.055 can never become a CORE manual buy candidate under the frozen <=20x and p*odds>=1.10 rules.
new_structural_findings_since_v36.one_ticket_concentration: Without ticket-specific price evidence, adding a lower-probability ticket worsens the equal-stake uniform-odds screening threshold; one-point 3renhuku remains the cleanest model-side candidate.

multi_venue_acquisition_state_carried_fr.source_integrity_rule: Never infer future race composition. Count only complete reproducible PRE racecards before target result visibility.

next_without_owner: Keep the current forward prespec, model freeze, price gate v2, ticket rule and thresholds unchanged while observations accumulate.
Use the new diagnostics only as non-decision-changing checks: identify CORE-impossible tickets below p=0.055 and label fallback-only consensus correctly.
Do not promote Girls/final/solo/venue/class into purchase rules from the same scored sample; log strata only.
When legitimate future evidence is available, test the strongest current candidate on genuine frozen PRE prices and post-event outcomes, including drawdown and winner-concentration controls.
A future challenger may add a genuinely independent uncertainty/calibration criterion, but only via separate preregistration on later unseen evidence.
Keep formal 30/60 support lane independent and protected holdouts unopened.
